evidence.quote: + A list of the protection packs (web ACLs) that are enabled for intelligent threat application integration. The list includes each protection pack (web ACL) that uses the `AWSManagedRulesACFPRuleSet` managed rule group, the `AWSManagedRulesATPRuleSet` managed rule group, or the targeted protection level of the `AWSManagedRulesBotControlRuleSet` managed rule group. When you implement the intelligent threat APIs, you use the integration URL for the protection pack (web ACL) that you want to integrate with.
